app.name: Contract Rater
app.tagline: Check a Qiwa employment contract against the Saudi Labor Law before you sign or publish it.

common.notFoundBody: The page you are looking for does not exist.

auth.signInSubtitle: Welcome back. Sign in to see your ratings.
auth.signUpSubtitle: Your account comes with a personal workspace. Only you can see its ratings.
auth.name: Full name
auth.inviteHint: You have an invitation to a workspace. Sign in, or create an account, with the email address the invitation is for.

errors.invalid_credentials: That email and password don't match. Try again.
errors.user_exists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.password_too_short: Use at least 8 characters for your password.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

workspace.label: Workspace
workspace.noneHint: Your account doesn't have a workspace yet. Create a company workspace, or sign out and in again to set up your personal one.
workspace.createDescription: HR teams use a company workspace to rate contracts together. Ratings in it open in the HR view by default.
workspace.nameError: Enter a name between 2 and 120 characters.
workspace.created: Workspace created. You're now working in {{name}}
workspace.changedElsewhere: Your workspace changed to {{name}}, probably in another tab, so nothing was saved here. Check it and try again.

upload.title: Rate a contract
upload.description: Upload a Qiwa Unified Employment Contract as a PDF, up to {{max}} MB.
upload.viewHint: You can switch between the two views on the report at any time.
upload.privacyBody_one: The PDF is stored encrypted and deleted automatically after {{count}} day. Names, ID numbers, IBANs, phone numbers and emails are removed before any text is analysed. You can delete the rating and its file at any time.
upload.privacyBody_other: The PDF is stored encrypted and deleted automatically after {{count}} days. Names, ID numbers, IBANs, phone numbers and emails are removed before any text is analysed. You can delete the rating and its file at any time.
upload.consent: I agree that Contract Rater may process this contract to produce a rating, as described above.
upload.notLegalAdvice: Contract Rater is a rating aid, not legal advice.
upload.started: Upload complete. Your rating has started.

errors.not_pdf: This file isn't a PDF. Upload the contract PDF you downloaded from Qiwa.
errors.too_large: This file is larger than {{max}} MB. Upload the original PDF from Qiwa.
errors.empty: This file is empty. Choose the contract PDF again.

ratings.title: Your ratings
ratings.intro: Find out whether a contract is fair to you, what money is at stake and what to ask for before you sign.
ratings.introCompany: Check your contracts for compliance and get suggested wording for risky clauses.
ratings.emptyHint: Upload a Qiwa contract above to get your first rating.
ratings.deleteBody: The rating, its findings and the uploaded PDF will be deleted for everyone in this workspace. This can't be undone.

report.title: Contract rating

viewIntro.employee: Written for the employee: what each clause means for you, the money at stake and what to ask for.
viewIntro.hr: Written for HR: compliance risk, the articles cited and suggested replacement wording.

report.lowConfidenceHint: Market fairness only checks allowance ratios, early-termination compensation (Art. 77) and transfer clauses for now. There is no salary data by occupation yet.
report.deadlinesEmpty: No deadlines found in this contract.
report.likelyVoidIntro: A court would likely not enforce these clauses and would apply the law instead. Leaving them in the contract invites disputes.
report.findingsEmpty: No issues found in this contract.

passage.label: In the contract
passage.alt: Page {{page}} of the contract with clause {{clause}} highlighted
passage.approximate: The exact lines were not found, so this shows {{clause}} as a whole.
passage.noText: No text was stored for this passage.
passage.deletedOn: The contract file was deleted on {{date}}, so only the clause text as rated is shown.
passage.deleted: The contract file is no longer stored, so only the clause text as rated is shown.
passage.unavailable: The page image could not be loaded; this is the clause text as rated.

report.needsReviewHint: The analyser couldn't give a reliable answer for this clause. Have a person read it.
report.needsReviewBanner: Parts of this rating need a person to check them. Compare the findings with your copy of the contract.
report.goodEmpty: Nothing in this contract stood out as better than the law.
report.rightsIntro: These rules of the Labor Law apply whatever the contract says.
report.inProgressBody: This usually takes less than two minutes. You can leave this page; the rating keeps running.
report.notFound: This rating doesn't exist or was deleted.

viewer.title: Contract

empty.good: Nothing stood out as better than the law.

viewer.textOnlyTitle: The contract file is no longer stored
viewer.textOnlyBody: It was deleted on {{date}}. The clause text as it was rated is shown instead.
viewer.textOnlyBodyNoDate: The clause text as it was rated is shown instead.
viewer.notReady: The contract viewer opens once the rating has finished.

kind.art77_gap: Compensation if the contract is ended early (SAR)
kind.leave_value: Value of the leave days at stake (SAR)

org.title: Workspace settings
org.personalNote: This is your personal workspace. Only you can see its ratings.
org.name: Name
org.retentionIntro: Uploaded PDFs are deleted automatically after this many days. Ratings and findings stay.
org.retentionOwnerOnly: Only the workspace owner can change this.
org.retentionInvalid: Enter a whole number of days between 1 and 365.
org.membersReadOnly: Only owners and admins can manage members.
org.removeBody: They will lose access to this workspace and its ratings. Ratings they uploaded stay.
org.inviteIntro: No email is sent. You get a link to share with the person yourself. It works for them once they sign in with the invited address.
org.inviteCreatedHint: Send this link to {{email}}. It works once they sign in or sign up with that address, until {{date}}.
org.copyFailed: Couldn't copy the link. Click it to select it, then copy it yourself.

invite.title: Workspace invitation
invite.details: You're invited as {{role}}. The invitation is for {{email}} and expires on {{date}}.
invite.privacy: Your personal workspace stays private. Ratings you upload in {{name}} can be seen by its owners and admins.
invite.joined: You joined {{name}} and are now working in it.
invite.notForYou: This invite is not for this account or has expired. You are signed in as {{email}}. To accept it, sign out and sign in with the address the invitation is for.

account.title: Account
account.name: Name
account.languageHint: The interface, dates and numbers follow this language.
account.deleteBody: Deletes every rating and uploaded PDF in your personal workspace, then signs you out. Company workspaces belong to your employer and are not affected.
account.noPersonal: You don't have a personal workspace, so there is nothing to delete here.
account.confirmBody: Every rating, finding and uploaded PDF in your personal workspace will be deleted, and you will be signed out. This can't be undone.
account.confirmCheck: I understand that this can't be undone.
account.deleted: Your data was deleted and you have been signed out.

errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that in this workspace.
errors.not_found: We couldn't find that. It may have been deleted.
errors.validation_error: Some of the information isn't valid. Check it and try again.
errors.unsupported_document: We couldn't read this as a Qiwa Unified Employment Contract. Upload the contract PDF exactly as downloaded from Qiwa: other documents and damaged or password-protected files can't be rated.
errors.file_too_large: The file is too large. Upload the original PDF from Qiwa.
errors.rate_limited: You've reached today's limit of new ratings. Try again tomorrow.
errors.conflict: That clashes with a recent change. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: Can't reach Contract Rater. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalid_response: The server sent an unexpected answer. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.rating_failed: The rating stopped before it finished. Try uploading the contract again.
errors.rating_timeout: The rating took too long and was stopped. Try uploading the contract again.
errors.document_missing: The contract file is no longer stored (it may have been deleted after the retention period), so it can't be rated. Upload it again.
